title: Last Conversation
about: The final quiet conversation between two people whose relationship had already slipped away.
description: This track remembers the last conversation at the end of the fair, after several days of distance and silence had already changed the relationship. There was no dramatic argument or emotional scene, just two people speaking one final time while everyone around them prepared to leave. The exact words have faded, but the meaning remains: sometimes a goodbye only reveals itself as the last conversation years after it happened.
lyrics: The music hadn't stopped just yet,
Though it didn't sound the same anymore.
We'd barely spoken for those last few days,
I wondered if we'd leave like strangers...
Then you came to find me
There wasn't anger in your voice,
No tears to fill the air.
The crowds kept moving all around,
Loading up for one last ride.
The fair was ending for everyone...
And you don't realize they're the last
